## Design

### 2026-10-18 – 16/10: Designing and Prototyping!

**3h**

16/10: Designing and Prototyping!

For this week’s CAD, I decided to make a desk organiser!
![IMG_7009](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/26dd15ebe8d0730f560aad373db0cfa14240295e993a9f556b80d966dd549b19.jpg)
Started off by listing down the items that could be placed in the organiser, then sketched out possible layouts and shapes for the organiser.

![IMG_7007](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/86e228249f7daa15e651b3ebf34f259224d3fc781c4e0282d1219db915231a88.jpg)
Started prototyping with paper (since I didn’t have any cardboard around). Made the pen holder part first and played around with how long or wide it should be. Decided it didn’t need to be so long and kinda ‘separated’ it to see if it could fit my scissors and ruler.

![IMG_7011](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d9982019213f0a80f09680d988b1a797a3592a8aa3c5900526b473b64218ac94.jpg)
Went on to make the ‘drawer’ and made sure it could fit the pens properly. Ended up making it shorter and less wide than originally planned.

![IMG_7013](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/57856d0b0646caa768c7be53a8bcfe21a72d41a7d98e9b97022a008ed1c2425a.jpg)
Lastly, I made a part to store sticky notes and tabs. Eventually laid them all out and made sure everything could fit properly and how many of each part I wanted (eg. 2 pen compartments)

### 2026-10-18 – 17/10: Installing Fusion 360 and starting on the CAD!

**2h**

17/10: Installing Fusion 360 and starting on the CAD!

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 5.04.20 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/aeacf6dddcf9f0e4f5b3dd87bb087d49077f22592d6f8e493fa4a7e2321af2c8.png)
Finally moving on to the actual CAD! Was a little intimidated at first, but the YouTube tutorials really helped. Although defining all the dimensions were pretty tedious, it was all worth it :D

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 5.32.08 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/6abacf5a176d0ae3507448b08b02b18741e552a7f85c2a15ad385983f9e3a461.png)
Finished with the grid base of my modular desk organiser! Took a long time...

### 2026-10-18 – Final Stretch: Modelling all the compartments and assembling them!

**5h**

Final Stretch: Modelling all the compartments and assembling them!

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 11.50.09 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/6c4dff91ef7f203fb541272d357579118c83d89bb8fbc6b509ccb63a99f76ee0.png)
Made the grid base solid! Took a pretty long time to figure out what I was doing wrong or wasn't doing at all haha but eventually got the base to have a base! (not just a hole right through) Learning this was very veryyy important for making everything else

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 12.14.37 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/07b5aa943b9e30df510a3a84369369a3d3a7090a8648990d6b7a0aba683e66bf.png)
Time to design the notes compartment! This one definitely took the longest out of all. Since I wanted it to be slanted, I had to change up the sketch (since it was originally just a rectangle) but I didn't know how to cut it into the shape I wanted! I tried making another sketch, and cutting from there but that didn't work because there was nothing to cut through... Turns out I just needed to connect the ends of the sketch into the desired shape instead of making it a rectangle... silly me! After that, I created the feet that would go sit on the grid base (yay!)

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 1.38.38 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d8d3e2e5f5c4d089842a101971c405f5755157b387448c152cfc71d12a1466c4.png)
Next up, the pen holdersssss! Took a look at my pens and settled with a loose diameter just in case :) First time working with circles here! Actually took a while because I didn't really know how to copy and paste the circles or make a circle pattern (tried googling and stuff but just decided to do it manually muahaha) Got all the dimensions down, and had to tweak them a little here and there to make all nice and centred.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 1.38.38 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d8d3e2e5f5c4d089842a101971c405f5755157b387448c152cfc71d12a1466c4.png)
Up next was a less daunting compartment: one for miscellaneous items (taking up 3 grids) Finally got the hang of all the stuff like making the base, (also kinda just realised while I'm writing this that I all I needed to do was to not cut through the whole solid... oh well!) and making the feet. Oh yes I learnt how to use the chamfer for the feet and also fillet to round the insides of the compartments.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 1.53.46 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/2f132f465627405a421535b300342cafdf874694b3b14032f866a4ecf55809c4.png)
![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 2.04.42 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/4155c834f5d43b93ff978a4e71ae9af1e53902c14d8ab9f0be7a0a11accd204e.png)
Lastly, all I had to do was model a single and double grid compartment to complete the organiser! These took less time, especially since I was more comfortable with Fusion after the first few. Felt very accomplished :D

### 2026-10-18 – Assembling the Parts!

**4.6h**

Assembling the Parts!

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 2.22.19 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/fac2c6771652a4830515daaab752749ab8e4ff24af1dc006c95ae874f452c0ea.png)
After modelling all of the separate compartments, it was finally time to assemble them together! And of course, so many things had to be changed after going through it. First of all, I completely forgot that I had a 4x5 grid instead of 4x4 grid which I was basing off as I was modelling my parts. And I didn't really want to just dump more compartments for the last row, so I decided to remove it! And that's where I faced a few challenges. On top of that, I also needed to change my note compartment's height to match the rest!

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 2.56.38 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/472c7ef3a99f2bc74d7f7f9b1025d15a8199ec9dc23a3510197de85cb044a006.png)
Updated 4x4 grid! It took a while because I had to remove all the excess that didn't need to be there anymore from the different layers and also found part of the solid sticking out... Luckily I had to go back and change things up, if not I definitely would not have noticed it! Fixed it up and finally, finally finished off my grid base. However, I also decided that the organiser would look nicer and be more sturdy if I had proper 'walls', so I built them! Although it was a tedious way, because when I created the sketch and tried to make it into the solid, the grid kept getting in the way!! >:( and I just couldn't properly extrude what I wanted. To fix that, I made the sketch bigger than the grid base so that I could properly select and extrude it, then edited and fixed the dimensions after. Worked like a charm :D

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 5.04.16 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/59bf6912fd906e14d684d1f20f62f8a41875c1df9805b8d797ffb76428282fb2.png)
Last compartment to amend!! Although, it almost made me pull my hair out.. I thought it would be pretty simple to change since all I needed to do was change its height from 75mm to 80mm. Maybe it was supposed to be. But guess what, I could even change the dimensions because they were locked in already and the dimensions wouldn't show even after clicking 'show dimensions' TT-TT this was pretty devastating. I tried surfing on YouTube, on Google, even ChatGPT, but nope, did not know why or how to solve my problem. So I decided why not just redo the design of the notes compartment haha! Well, I'm sure it took less time than me trying to solve my problem. So yep I redid the design, with the correct dimensions. Only realised it was upside down(?) after completing it but that one should be fine. YAY I'm finally doneee!!!!

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 3.33.03 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/e8d994dc629d9ac7c23a93b1f579962849f5863b3ca196eb7e9eac3b5614e52f.png)
Assembled everything together and made sure they all fit. Got a lil jumpscare when it looked like the compartments didn't match up to the grids, but when it was positioned correctly, they fit woohoo success! I am pretty proud of this project, since I didn't need to follow a guide like I did for Starbie and ended up having loads of fun :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 at 5.15.27 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/f1d35688a85b64510f39ff52c76245ebe4bf92bf677c975d1bc7d9e25e0f2dfc.png)
After, compiling all the files (so many omg), everything was added to my GitHub repo. Wrote up my README and that was it!
The end of Week 2 - CAD :D
